headline: Taiwan stocks rise 1,106 points this week; total market cap of listed companies climbs to NT$144.5 trillion | Securities
summary: The Taiex closed Friday at 44,225.91 points, up 1,106.16 points or 2.56% for the week. Total market value of listed companies reached NT$144.5568 trillion, about NT$3.7 trillion higher than the prior week.
why: The Taiex is Taiwan's benchmark stock index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor companies such as TSMC.
